description: Record the verdict: a sheet edit (UPDATE) or a character rebuild (RECREATE). Call EXACTLY ONCE, then finish work immediately.
name: decide

mode.description: UPDATE — the sheet's FOUNDATION (class/subclass/race/concept) does not change, the content is edited: spells, features, stats, gear, level-up of its own subclass — including rebuilding the choices toward a goal ("make it more combat-ready/effective"), even when the sheet is full to the brim per the class table (the executor keeps within the limits by REPLACING). RECREATE — the foundation itself changes: a different class/subclass/race/subrace/base concept/look. Doubt about the FOUNDATION — RECREATE, doubt about the SCOPE of work — UPDATE.

reason.description: Brief rationale (1-2 sentences) — goes to the telemetry log, not to the player.

description: Transition to another state (phase) of work. Call it once the current phase's work is complete — as the LAST call of the SAME response that finishes that work (when the phase rules allow the transition). The switch is applied at the END of this response: every other call in the same response still runs in the CURRENT phase, so it is safe to finish the phase's work and request the transition together. Do not spend a separate response on a lone transition call, and do not place new work AFTER the transition expecting the new phase.
name: transitionTo
